Docket 1.3.107

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

Five wrong findings fixed. Each was found by auditing our own sites and checking the finding against the page.

- *A date and a sentence are not a street address.* A line like "last updated
  2026-09-15 The fastest way: just ask" was read as the address "15 The fastest
  way". That made a Mac app look like a local business, and its two worst findings
  were "no phone number" and "no LocalBusiness schema". The day of a date can no
  longer start an address, and the words of a street name have to be capitalised.
  Real addresses, including hyphenated house numbers, still match.
- *Dates are not a phone number.* "Licence through 03/2027. 2018 – 2019" was read
  as a phone number, and the report said the number was not a clickable link on a
  site with no phone. A month and a year joined by a slash, or two years in one
  run, are no longer a number. Numbers that end in a year still are.
- *Where a person lives is not a local business.* A portfolio whose markup is a
  Person with a home city and coordinates no longer gets the local-business
  findings. A company's address, a Place and a LocalBusiness still do.
- *Pages that name another as their canonical do not compete with it.* Two pages
  that point their canonical at a third were listed as rivals of it, with advice
  to redirect them, which the canonical already does.
- *An index page no longer joins a whole series into one search.* A page that
  resembled each of 28 state pages put all 29 in one group. The same happened to a
  set of calculators and to a section index beside one page inside it. On one site
  the finding went from 53 pages in 6 groups to the pairs that really overlap.
  Virginia and West Virginia are now two places. Two pages that are one search, in
  a series or not, are still reported.

99 checks across 13 areas.
